<color=#00AEFF>Function: Gains a buff when obtaining Scraps.

costumes.name: Junkyard Vanguard
costumes.description:
E.H. costume.
Obtained from an Event Pass.

lines.text: I owe you a great debt for everything you've done for me. I promise to pay you back in any way I can.
I want to atone for what I've done. I may not be forgiven, but... I still want to do it.
I used to think that as long as you were in the right, any means were justified, no matter how terrible. I realized far too late just how wrong I was...
There are no shortcuts when you're trying to walk the right path. I understand that now, which is why I'm just doing my best.
I thought I could change the world and save people. I was so blinded by this sense of duty that I couldn't even see the terrible things I was doing...
Thank you for trusting me, even after everything that's happened. As I move forward, I won't forget the weight of my sins.
Looks like you're pretty busy. I'll go ahead and do my own thing.
This place is peaceful and warm, even when you're away... Is it really okay for me to be here?
This place is... really peaceful. It's exactly the kind of place I wanted the Outer Rim to become...
If you have something to tell me while I'm gone, leave a message at the Trendy Bar. ... Oh, you'll just text me? Yeah, that works too.
All the Nikkes here look so happy... I suppose that's all thanks to your efforts.
It's me, E.H. I'll do everything in my power to help, just as you helped me.
I'm once again in your debt.
Where did you even manage to find all these materials?
I'll do everything I can to prove that your trust in me is not misplaced.
Is it really okay for me to accept something this nice?
I really needed this... Thank you for getting it for me. I swear to repay you someday.
You really don't have to be this nice to me... Still, I do appreciate it.
It feels like all I ever do is get help from you... I don't know how to express my gratitude.
I think I understand why so many Nikkes rely on you. Your words and actions naturally inspire trust.
You really are an incredible person. You actually might just be able to change the world...
Good. I'll go with you.
Okay. What do you need me to do?
Sure, I'll get moving.
... Here they come.
Stay back. I'll take care of this.
I'll put a stop to all of them.
Locked and loaded. Engaging now.
Reloading.
... This is taking a while. Stay hidden.
This body's sturdier than I thought. I like it.
I've got this.
Just gotta do my best. No shortcuts.
Now...!
Clear.
Good.
Next.
Agh.
Ugh.
Not good.
Sorry... I just need a little maintenance.
The way's clear now. Let's go.
It's been so long since I dressed like this... Do I look weird?
No matter how fancy my outfit may be, I'm still part of the Outer Rim. That will never change.
The representative of the Outer Rim... I don't know if I really deserve to be called that.
The whole reason I'm able to dress like this and represent the Outer Rim is because of you. Thank you. Really.
I can hardly remember the last time I got all dressed up... I'm feeling a little self-conscious, especially with you here.
With everyone putting their trust in me, I'm going to do all I can to finally bring light to the Outer Rim.
You seem busy right now. That's too bad... There were some things I wanted to talk about.
You're always working so hard. I suppose that's how you've achieved so much.
Do you think the Outer Rim will ever be filled with this much light someday...?
I can always tell how much of a mark you've left on this place. Everyone looks happy and at peace.
When you have time, come visit the Trendy Bar. There are a lot of things I'd like to talk to you about.
I hope you'll watch over me as I continue to fulfill my responsibilities. It'll help me stand firm.
With your help, I feel like I can do just about anything.
Thanks for the support. I'll do my best.
I'm going to do all I can to live up to the trust you've put in me.
I don't think I really deserve something like this...
Thanks. I'm going to get you something in return next time.
When did you even have time to get this? You're really amazing...
I'll always remember everything you've done for me. Not like I could ever forget...
No matter what position I may hold, I'll never betray you.
You've become just as important to me as the people of the Outer Rim that I must protect.
If you want me to go, I'm ready.
Do you need anything?
All right. I'll head over there.
Enemy spotted.
Don't worry. I can still fight in this outfit.
No matter what happens, I'll protect you.
For the Outer Rim.
I can do a bit better. Here goes.
Okay... all set.
All right. Here I go again.
I'm ready.
Light to the Outer Rim!
It's time. Let's do this!
Enemy down.
Next target.
Whew...
Agh.
Ugh.
Urgh... I'm all right.
Agh... I think I need to regroup. Sorry I couldn't help.
All cleared. Let's keep moving.
